pages.text: The Cave Centipede is a rare, subterranean arthropod that can be found deep in caves. It is hostile towards anyone who would find themselves in its domain. Although slow, this cumbersome and giant arthropod can deal a dangerous amount of damage and has a poisonous bite.

When slain, they have a chance to drop one or more of their legs. These legs can be used to craft a pair of leggings that grants its wearer the ability to climb walls, along with increased defense. They can also be brewed with a Poisonous Essence or a Bottle of Komodo Dragon Spit in order to create a Potion of Poison Resistance. This enables its user not to suffer the effects of poison.
